title: ServiceNow Analyst
jobDescription: At Arctic Wolf, you won’t just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve – you'll help lead the change. Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We’re proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Gartner Peer Insights and IDC Market Scape – but what matters most is the work behind it: delivering real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora Platform. If you’re looking for meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high-growth company that’s redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you! Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for a Service Now Analyst to be part of making this/that happen Position Overview and Objective The Service Now Analyst supports the delivery of technical solutions on the Service Now platform and provides administration, application development, maintenance, and technical support. Working under the guidance of senior team members, the analyst uses good practice web programming techniques to configure reliable solutions on the Service Now platform. Responsibilities As a Service Now Analyst you will: Assist in planning, executing, monitoring, and completing technical tasks related to the configuration and implementation of the Service Now platform. Provide software coding and customization including, but not limited to: screen tailoring, workflow administration, report setup, data imports, integration, scripting, third party software integrations, and custom application development Update and maintain a comprehensive testing protocol for Service Now instance upgrades with the purpose of certifying all applications for use after the upgrade completes. Help troubleshoot and resolve technical data and transformation issues, escalating more complex problems as needed. Help gather and interpret business requirements to support sustainable solutions in Service Now. Answer “how to” technical and application configuration questions. Develop, maintain, and execute reports to ensure system operation meets performance targets. Create and maintain system design and operations documentation. You will perform day-to-day support and maintenance, work with the functional team to develop solutions in Service Now, and contribute to support and development efforts within the admin team. General support, administration, and maintenance of Service Now platform and associated applications. Work closely with Service Now functional teams and implementation partners to build requested items and tasks using workflows to manage processes from the customer to the fulfillment teams. Configure and improve core and custom applications. Work directly with process owners to resolve support issues within Service Now. Monitor health, usage and overall compliance of Service Now and its applications Develop systems integrations and process automation. Create and configure Business Rules, UI Policies, UI Actions, Client Scripts and ACLs, including scripting of each. Create and configure Notifications, UI pages, UI Macros, Script Includes, Formatters, etc. in Service Now. Configuring and managing Discovery and Orchestration. Support application and platform upgrades. Load, manipulate and maintain data between Service-now and other systems. Create Service Now reports and dashboards. Experience and Requirements: We’re looking for someone with experience in: Manage users, groups, roles, and permissions Configure forms, tables, and catalog items Maintain platform security and access controls (ACLs) Support upgrades and platform releases Monitor platform health and performance Key Competencies Process Optimization Analytical problem solving Stakeholder partnership Governance and risk management Internal customer focus Continuous improvement mindset Minimum Qualifications BS degree in Information Technology/Computer Science or equivalent combination of education and experience. 2 years of demonstrated experience in Service Now development, administration, or configuration. Environment and Physical Demands Work is primarily sedentary in nature and can be executed sitting or standing in positions in an office environment. Requires ability to utilize technology related to using a keyboard, verbal communication, and work with device screens which require visual acuity. If located in a company office, often requires the mobility to physically navigate the space. In the event of business travel, mobility sufficient to utilize public and private transport and navigate to essential locations. May include moving or lifting of 25 pounds or less (e.g., office chair, reams of paper). On-Camera Policy To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations. About Arctic Wolf At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including Top Workplace USA (2021-2025), Best Places to Work – USA (2021-2025), Great Place to Work – Canada (2021-2024), Great Place to Work – UK (2024-2026), and Kununu Top Company – Germany (2024-2026). Our commitment to bold growth and shaping the future of security operations is matched by our dedication to customer satisfaction, with over 10,000 customers worldwide and more than 2,000 channel partners globally. As we continue to expand globally and enhance our technology, Arctic Wolf remains the most trusted name in the industry. Our Values Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion and truly value the unique qualities and unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. And we appreciate that—by protecting people’s and organizations’ sensitive data and seeking to end cyber risk— we get to work in an industry that is fundamental to the greater good. We celebrate unique perspectives by creating a platform for all voices to be heard through our Pack Unity program. We encourage all employees to join or create a new alliance. See more about our Pack Unity here. We also believe and practice corporate responsibility, and have recently joined the Pledge 1% Movement, ensuring that we continue to give back to our community. We know that through our mission to End Cyber Risk we will continue to engage and give back to our communities. All India wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including: Equity for all employees Flexible annual leave, paid holidays and volunteer days Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical insurance for you and your family, life insurance (3x compensation), and personal accident insurance. Fertility support and paid parental leave Employee Assistance Program Arctic Wolf is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics, or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law. Arctic Wolf is committed to fostering a welcoming, accessible, respectful, and inclusive environment ensuring equal access and participation for people with disabilities. As such, we strive to make our entire experience as accessible as possible and provide accommodations as required for candidates and employees with disabilities and/or other specific needs where possible. Please let us know if you require any accommodation by emailing recruiting@arcticwolf.com. View our Hiring Page to learn more about our application process. ROLE:
As an EM Content & Integrations Developer on Arctic Wolf’s Aurora Exposure Management team, you get the opportunity to work as both a cybersecurity researcher and a Detections/Vulnerability developer. You’ll identify areas to improve the platform’s threat and vulnerability and configuration risk detection capabilities. Your overarching goal is to improve security posture for Arctic Wolf’s clients. This role works cross-functionally with Product Management, Security Services, and various other specialists to continuously improve the coverage and efficacy of their Exposure Management portfolio and solutions What you’ll be doing: Work with team members to continuously improve coverage, efficiency and deliver customer-facing and internal services. Cloud Config and Posture Management: Development of security policy in cloud service providers Assist in operational teams to resolve unexpected results, receive feedback and improve detection efficacy. Full understanding and use of Dev Ops methods and practices Understanding and ability to work with test-driven development. Our impact speaks for itself: we've earned recognition on the Forbes Cloud 100, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fortune Future 50, and Fortune Cyber 60 lists, and we recently took home the 2024 CRN Products of the Year award. We're proud to be named a Leader in the IDC Market Scape for Worldwide Managed Detection and Response Services and earning a Customers' Choice distinction from Gartner Peer Insights. Our Aurora Platform also received CRN's Products of the Year award in the inaugural Security Operations Platform category. Join a company that's not only leading, but also shaping, the future of security operations. Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We're looking for a Senior Developer 2 to be part of making this happen. About You You're an experienced software developer who has the ability to perform programming tasks and large engineering projects with independence and expertise. You demonstrate mastery over software development practices, and easily develop reusable design patterns. You have worked closely in a global team of professionals with different cultures and backgrounds to form one unit with a strong sense of purpose. You will learn as you teach, making the whole more than the sum. Position Overview and Objective A highly skilled developer responsible for delivering major product features independently, mentoring team members, and driving technical excellence across software development practices. Plays a key role in architecture, design, and strategic initiatives. This role is based in Bangalore, India and will require close collaboration with engineering teams in North America (USA and Canada). Arctic Wolf places a strong emphasis on delivering high- quality outcomes with efficiency; candidates must demonstrate a consistent commitment to engineering excellence, quality, and operational efficiency in all aspects of software development. The role also requires a strong understanding of how AI tools can be applied across the SDLC to improve productivity and delivery outcomes. Job Scope Leverage AI tools such as Git Hub Copilot and Claude to improve efficiency in coding, debugging, testing, and documentation activities across the SDLC. Apply AI-assisted workflows to complete development tasks more efficiently while maintaining high standards of quality. Experience training or enabling other team members to effectively use AI tools is desired. Maintain a strong focus on quality and efficiency, ensuring all deliverables meet Arctic Wolf's standards for engineering excellence. Has comprehensive knowledge of software development practices, mastery over writing and debugging code, and also provides feedback to others on the team to understand the same. Performs complex programming tasks and implements software systems, often including other team members as part of the effort. Assumes responsibility for the quality and delivery of their code. Participates in architecture reviews and technical design sessions. Completes major product features with little or no guidance. Able to resolve dependencies across other teams.  Activities: o Consistent and active participation in Team development activities (Daily Scrums, Retrospectives, Test Fest, etc.) o Join daily standup, take on tasks by priority (proactively selects next story for example) o Support on-call rotation, able to support o Supporting other developers to unblock and training as needed o Setting standards of maintainable code practice and continuously improving upon them o Embodies good quality from requirements, use-case, design and code. o Complex programming tasks. o Participate in arch and HLD meetings o Reviews peers' code and provides detailed feedback. o Active role in retrospectives, test fest etc. o Takes ownership of cross-functional dependencies and aligns with other teams. o Coaching through pairing, code examples, or knowledge share sessions o Reviewing and providing input to HLDs o Awareness of business objectives and identification of work application to those objectives o Understand design patterns and design anti-patterns. o Help grow and develop others in the team. o Mentor junior members in the team. o Identifies and addresses technical debt and bottlenecks in the system. o Aligns deliverables with broader business objectives and OKRs. o Designs and delivers Proofs of Concept (POCs) for high-impact project o Leads brainstorming sessions for architectural and strategic initiatives.  Outcomes: o Takes full ownership of major product features and ensures their successful delivery. o Drives alignment between engineering deliverables and organizational strategy. o Establishes best practices and introduces innovative solutions to systemic challenges. Complexity & Problem Solving Addresses organizational challenges by tackling highly ambiguous problems with innovative approaches.  Activities: o Works on proof-of-concepts (POCs) to clarify approaches. o Identifies patterns and anti-patterns to drive best practices. o Innovates solutions that address strategic goals.  Outcomes: o Introduces innovative solutions to organizational problems. o Drives systemic improvements and sets Knowledge & Experience Possesses tech, product and domain expertise. Good understanding of the competitive marker landscape. Focuses on organizational challenges.  Activities: o High-impact, cross-functional initiatives. o Removes complex tech debt in the system. o Provides strategy and direction o Able to identify "better together" solutions. o Provides strategic direction on complex technical challenges.  Outcomes: o Drives innovation and alignment across the organization. o Resolves systemic technical challenges while advancing strategic initiatives. Collaboration & Interaction A cross-team leader driving organizational collaboration and knowledge sharing.  Activities: o Actively mentors engineers on a regular weekly cadence. o Works on multiple repos, teams, o Conducts knowledge sharing sessions o Leads technical workshops o Works with multiple stakeholders (PM, Pg M, etc) o Drives post-mortems and retrospectives  Outcomes: o Improved team processes and decision-making. Achieve Results Aligns outcomes with organizational goals.  Activities: o High-impact, cross-functional initiatives. o Removes complex tech debt in the system. Environment and Physical Demands Work is primarily sedentary in nature and can be executed sitting or standing positions in an office environment. Requires ability to utilize technology related to using a keyboard, verbal communication, and work with device screens which require visual acuity. If located in a company office, often requires the mobility to physically navigate space. In the event of business travel, mobility is sufficient to utilize public and private transport and navigate to essential locations. May include moving or lifting of 25 pounds or less (e.g. office chair, reams of paper). This is reflected in our multiple awards, including Top Workplace USA (2021-2024), Best Places to Work - USA (2021-2024), Great Place to Work - Canada (2021-2024), Great Place to Work - UK (2024), and Kununu Top Company - Germany (2024). Our commitment to bold growth and shaping the future of security operations is matched by our dedication to customer satisfaction, with over 7,000 customers worldwide and more than 2,000 channel partners globally. title: Staff Threat Intelligence Researcher
jobDescription: At Arctic Wolf, you will not just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve – you will help lead the change. Our global team is made up of people who thrive on solving complex problems, moving quickly, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We are proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Gartner Peer Insights, and International Data Corporation Market Scape. What matters most is the work behind these recognitions: delivering real outcomes for customers through award-winning innovation such as our Aurora Platform. If you are looking for meaningful work, smart teammates, and the opportunity to make a real impact in a high-growth company that is redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you. Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We are looking for a Staff Threat Intelligence Researcher to help achieve this mission. The Staff Threat Intelligence Researcher will contribute to our Threat Intelligence organization by leading advanced cyber threat intelligence research and translating adversary insights into measurable defensive outcomes. This role focuses on deep technical analysis, adversary tracking, intelligence-driven detection, and operational collaboration to improve threat visibility, detection coverage, and incident response effectiveness across the organization. As a senior technical authority, this role will shape intelligence methodologies, establish analytical standards, mentor peers, and deliver actionable intelligence that directly strengthens Arctic Wolf’s security operations and customer protection capabilities. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: • Lead and contribute to threat actor, malware family, and campaign tracking by correlating malware samples, infrastructure, delivery mechanisms, and adversary tradecraft • Conduct end-to-end cyber threat intelligence research aligned with established frameworks such as the Cyber Threat Intelligence lifecycle, MITRE ATT&CK, and the Diamond Model • Perform static and dynamic malware analysis across malicious binaries, scripts, and document-based delivery mechanisms • Investigate malicious network infrastructure and command-and-control activity by pivoting across domains, Internet Protocol addresses, certificates, and related artifacts • Translate intelligence findings into actionable detection and threat hunting logic using technologies such as YARA, Sigma, and Suricata • Analyze Windows or mac OS internals including application programming interfaces, obfuscation techniques, system calls, and execution behaviors • Apply advanced open-source intelligence techniques, pivoting methodologies, and enrichment across multiple intelligence platforms and data sources • Research Deep Web ecosystems including crimeware-as-a-service and ransomware-as-a-service operations • Analyze and correlate large-scale datasets using technologies such as Structured Query Language, Python, or Excel to extract actionable intelligence insights • Develop automation and enrichment workflows using scripting languages such as Python • Partner closely with Security Operations Center and Managed Detection and Response teams to operationalize intelligence into detection, triage, and response workflows • Support Request for Intelligence workflows by delivering timely and actionable intelligence to operational teams • Provide escalation support for high-confidence threat events, including enrichment, attribution context, and recommended response actions • Contribute real-time intelligence support during active incidents and investigations • Develop intelligence-to-detection feedback loops that improve coverage and operational visibility • Create scalable intelligence dissemination methods including alerts, intelligence briefs, and knowledge base updates • Standardize analytical frameworks, intelligence validation practices, and operational research methodologies • Publish technical research, tradecraft methodologies, blogs, whitepapers, or present at industry workshops and conferences YOU WILL BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE IF: • You have 10+ years of relevant experience and you are recognized as a technical authority within one or more adversary ecosystems such as ransomware, financially motivated crimeware, or nation-state operations • You have strong experience in cyber threat intelligence research, adversary tracking, and intelligence analysis • You have hands-on experience applying threat intelligence to detection engineering, threat hunting, incident response, or threat modeling • You have experience with malware analysis tooling, host telemetry, and network telemetry analysis • You possess strong knowledge of modern threat intelligence frameworks and methodologies • You have experience translating intelligence into measurable operational outcomes and defensive improvements • You are comfortable working independently within highly ambiguous and rapidly evolving threat environments • You have strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills • You have experience mentoring peers and shaping technical standards within research organizations • You are passionate about improving intelligence-driven security operations and defensive capabilities Nice to have: • Experience publishing threat research, whitepapers, or presenting at industry conferences • Experience collaborating with external intelligence-sharing communities or trusted industry partners • Experience building scalable threat intelligence workflows and operational frameworks • Familiarity with large-scale telemetry analysis and data science methodologies • Experience automating intelligence workflows and enrichment pipelines WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE: • Improved detection effectiveness and operational visibility across Arctic Wolf security platforms • Actionable intelligence that directly strengthens incident response, threat hunting, and detection engineering outcomes • Measurable improvements in detection coverage and escalation quality through intelligence-led enhancements • Reduced response times and increased operational efficiency for threat intelligence support workflows • Development of scalable methodologies, analytical standards, and intelligence validation practices • High-confidence intelligence reporting that improves customer security outcomes and organizational threat awareness Do not meet all the requirements? That is okay. We still encourage you to apply. We have many opportunities and are always looking for strong talent. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations. At Arctic Wolf, we're redefining the cybersecurity landscape. With our employee Pack members, spread out globally, committed to setting new industry standards. Our accomplishments speak for themselves, from our recognition in the Forbes Cloud 100, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fortune Future 50, and Fortune Cyber 60 to winning the 2024 CRN Products of the Year award. We’re proud to be named a Leader in the IDC Market Scape for Worldwide Managed Detection and Response Services and earning a Customers' Choice distinction from Gartner Peer Insights. Our Aurora Platform also received CRN’s Products of the Year award in the inaugural Security Operations Platform category. Join a company that’s not only leading, but also shaping, the future of security operations. Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for a Senior Developer
- Security Research Services Development (SRSD) to be part of making this happen. About the

ROLE:
Design, develop, and maintain backend services and microservices using Python, Go, and cloud-native technologies. Build secure, scalable systems leveraging AWS services including RDS, Dynamo DB, and Kubernetes. Integrate software components into robust, production-ready systems with clear documentation and maintainability. Mentor junior developers and contribute to team growth through knowledge sharing and technical leadership. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand product requirements and deliver impactful solutions. Apply test-driven development and CI/CD practices using tools like Git, Jenkins, Terraform, and Docker. Solve complex problems creatively, using advanced analytical and debugging techniques. Participate in R&D demos and annual hackathons to showcase innovation and explore new ideas. What You Bring: 4-9 years of professional software development experience, with a strong focus on backend systems. Proven ability to work independently on large-scale features and systems. Deep understanding of software engineering principles, cloud architecture, and secure coding practices. Experience with Python/Go programming languages. Hands-on experience with container orchestration (Kubernetes), System designing. Familiarity with cloud platforms (preferably AWS) and distributed systems. Strong collaboration and communication skills, with a passion for mentoring and team development. . Cybersecurity, such as threat intelligence, threat detection, SIEM, EDR/XDR, malware analysis, security analytics, identity security, or cloud security. AI Agent development, including experience with LLM-based applications and agentic frameworks such as Lang Chain, Lang Graph, Langfuse, RAG, MCP, vector databases, AI evaluation, prompt engineering, or agent orchestration. title: Senior UX Designer (AI , Figma )
jobDescription:
At Arctic Wolf, you won’t just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve – you'll help lead the change. Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We’re proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Bartner Peer Insights and IDC Market Scape – but what matters most is the work behind it: delivering real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora Platform. If you’re looking for meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high-growth company that’s redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you! Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for A Senior UX Designer to be part of making this/that happen. The Senior UX Designer will contribute to our XDR department. About the

ROLE:
It’s an exciting time for the UX Team at Arctic Wolf.
The company is growing and we need great people to join our UX Team. We work in multi-disciplinary teams of UX Researchers & Designers, Software Developers and Product Managers to create solutions that delight our customers. We are passionate about creating intuitive, time-saving, and beautiful user & customer experiences and we’re looking for someone to join our team and help fulfil our mission. The Senior UX Designer is responsible for being an advocate for our end users and helping build user interfaces and experiences that solve user problems and produce measurable UX outcomes. You will collaborate with Agile development teams to implement solutions and work through constraints. As a Sr. UX Designer you will plan, design, and facilitate effective UX projects and help development teams execute designs by participating in all phases of the design process from concept, to prototype, to production. Responsibilities Include: • Lead team members in Product Management, Development, and Security Services to understand & deliver the key features identified in the Product Team roadmaps • Collaborate with UX Researchers on research methods and conduct your own research activities to gain insight and feedback from end users. • Create as-is and to-be user journeys, information architecture maps, and user task-flows to document problems, capture opportunities to improve, and communicate solutions • Design AI enhanced and augmented cybersecurity features / functions that deliver ideal functional allocation of tasks among humans and AI agents, and leverage the latest best practices and techniques for AI-driven user experiences • Collaborate with Product Management and Agile Development teams to plan, design and build features, usability updates and new product ideas. • Design and prototype highly interactive experience concepts, using the latest AI tooling to iterate quickly, based on reviews and customer feedback. • Seek out the most relevant and insightful feedback based on the needs of the project to improve designs and validate assumptions. • Contribute to Arctic Wolf Design Guidelines, Design Principles and Design System. • Coach fellow UX team members working in an agile development environment and facilitate collaboration with cross-functional roles. We value a culture of sharing, so every team member has opportunities to share their work with colleagues and stakeholders. Once a year we hold a company-wide Hackathon, teaming up across all R&D teams over four days to collaborate and build cool ideas outside the normal project scope. While innovation is the focus, some of these ideas do make it into our products. About You • You have experience as a UX Designer, including experience applying multiple user-centered design methods to solve user problems. • You understand Web Accessibility and have a solid understanding WCAG guidelines and levels. • You can model individual persona task-flows and workflows from the perspective of multiple personas. • You have designed for complex Information Architecture and UI patterns to support navigation in both desktop and mobile. • You are deeply familiar with common HCI principles and heuristics. • You have experience doing in-person and remote research techniques such as in-person discussions, remote interviews, remote testing, recording and online collaboration sessions. • You have some familiarity with AI tools, e.g. Figma Make, Claude Code or Cowork, Co-pilot, and you’re excited about using AI to accelerate the pace and quality of UX deliverables and measurable outcomes. • You have some familiarity with service design principles and methodologies, e.g. service blueprints, and a basic understanding of human factors fundamentals. Prior team leadership and/or management experience is a plus but not required. Previous experience working in the cybersecurity domain is preferred but not required. We provide cybersecurity training during onboarding and via on-the-job training. Job Description At Arctic Wolf, you won’t just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve – you'll help lead the change. Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We’re proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Gartner Peer Insights and IDC Market Scape – but what matters most is the work behind it: delivering real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora Platform. If you’re looking for meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high-growth company that’s redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you! Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for a Sr. Dev Ops Engineer to be part of making this happen. The Sr. Dev Ops Engineer will contribute to our IDR department . About the

ROLE:
We are looking for a highly skilled Sr. Dev Ops Engineer Engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable, reproducible lab environments to support integration with third-party vendors. This role is critical in enabling fast, reliable onboarding of external systems by providing production-like environments, automation, and debugging support for integration workflows. You will work closely with engineering, product, and partner teams to accelerate integration development, testing, and validation across diverse vendor ecosystems. Basic

QUALIFICATIONS:
6+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, Dev Ops, or similar roles with hands-on Python scripting capabilities. Hands-on experience with infrastructure-as-code tooling — Terraform for VM provisioning, Packer for VM templating, and Ansible for configuration management, including writing and maintaining roles, modules, and playbooks in a team setting with PR-based review Practical experience deploying and managing workloads on at least two of: VMware v Sphere/ESXi, AWS, Azure, GCP, or Proxmox, with a solid understanding of VM lifecycle, networking, and snapshots Working knowledge of containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, or Open Shift) is a plus Linux system administration skills, including shell scripting (and/or Python), for automating provisioning and configuration tasks Comfort building and consuming REST APIs, and working in a platform where provisioning is driven programmatically rather than through manual console steps Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and version control (Git/Git Hub), including pull-request-based contribution and peer review workflows A collaborative engineering mindset — writing environment definitions, playbooks, or modules that other engineers across the organization will read, reuse, and build on Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills, with experience using monitoring/observability tooling (e.g., Splunk, Grafana, Nagios) to validate environment health and performance. Enough security domain knowledge to build environments that are meaningful for detection engineering and SOC workflows — exposure to attack scenarios, incident response, or threat-informed defence is valued Experience with Windows Active Directory environments — designing, deploying, or troubleshooting AD, DNS, DHCP, and Windows Server infrastructure — is a strong plus. Position Overview and Objective The Senior Net Suite Developer operates as a senior system administrator within the Business Applications team, partnering closely with Business Applications administrators, and managers,to ensure secure, consistent, and well‑governed use of Net Suite across the organization. This role is responsible for administering, maintaining, and enhancing the Net Suite platform based on approved business priorities, with increased accountability for solution quality, data integrity, and operational resilience. The administrator translates complex financial and operational requirements into robust system configurations, ensuring core processes are supported through reliable architecture, controlled change management, and scalable design.Operating within established enterprise standards and governance frameworks, the administrator plays an active role in improving system maturity—identifying optimization opportunities, strengthening controls, and ensuring Net Suite enables efficiency, compliance, and long‑term scalability for supported teams. While adhering to disciplined execution, documentation, and change/release processes, this role goes beyond task execution to provide guidance on best practices, assess downstream impacts, and proactively mitigate risk. Through advanced system administration, issue resolution, reporting enablement, and integration oversight, the administrator contributes strategically to the stability and continuous improvement of Net Suite as a core enterprise platform supporting business objectives. Primary Responsibilities and Duties may include: System Administration & Configuration Support system configuration, workflows, and day-to-day activities for Net Suite within defined standards and guidance. Assist with managing system updates and releases, supporting planned rollout activities and validation steps. Monitor application storage usage and perform data archiving activities as required. Create and maintain standard reports and assist with approved ad hoc reporting requests. Perform advanced scripting and development work under direction. Create and maintain test cases for assigned enhancements and fixes (including regression where applicable), and document outcomes to support release readiness and controlled deployments. Support deployments using established best practices, including following change control, completing required validations, and coordinating release steps through the team’s release cadence and readiness reviews to reduce risk and user impact. Internal Team Partnership Work primarily with Business Applications administrators and managers to support requirement clarification and execution of approved priorities. Participate in internal working sessions to understand assigned changes, dependencies, and implementation expectations. Partner with team members to support adoption activities following planned change initiatives. Change Execution & Documentation Execute assigned work in accordance with established change control and release management processes. Reference, update, and maintain documentation related to Net Suite support, enhancements, and operational procedures using approved templates. Support & Issue Resolution Act as an individual contributor, resolving issues routed through established Business Applications team support and escalation channels. Troubleshoot assigned system, configuration, access, and data issues using documented procedures and guidance. Identify repeat issues and escalate appropriately for backlog consideration. Integrations & System Awareness Maintain working knowledge of existing Net Suite integrations and their role within the broader application ecosystem. Assess potential downstream impact of assigned changes and escalate integration considerations as needed. Support testing and validation related to planned integration updates. Access & Governance Support Assist with user access reviews and audits, including validation of roles, permissions, and data visibility. Support remediation of access issues identified through audits or reviews. Assist with maintaining user and role changes in response to approved business and departmental updates. Help install and validate approved managed packages and tools within the environment. Key Skills Solid problem-solving skills. Ability to understand our organization’s business. Ability to understand our Business Tool ecosystem. Understanding i Paa S solutions (e.g. Jitterbit, Boomi, etc.) and how your tool stack connects to other internal applications (Adaptive/ Pigment, Avalara, Workday, Navan, Avalara etc.). The ability to quickly acquire working knowledge of connected business tools is a plus; these tools include but may not be limited to (Adaptive/Pigment, High Radius, Workday, Navan, Avalara, Zip etc.). Computer literate and proficient in standard office applications for Word, Excel and Outlook. Collaborative and consultative abilities to work with non-technical end users. Aptitude for eliciting user requirements and developing both process and technical solutions. Key Competencies Working knowledge of SOX compliance and tracking. Ability to manage individual work efforts as part of the Jira Sprint/Release process. Working knowledge (preferably in a development environment) of Java Script/Suite Script, SQL, and HTML. Exposure to REST/SOAP, APIs, XML/JSON and SSO/TBA Finance/Accounting exposure and/or background are also preferred. Minimum Qualifications 5-10 years of Net Suite administration experience Obtainment or pursuit of base Net Suite Admin Certification preferred (e.g. Suite Foundation, Administration) Interest in other preferred Net Suite Certifications include ERP Consultant, Financial User, Suite Analytics, Application Developer, etc. Willingness to continue growing through experience and/or study and certification. Minimum expectation of a bachelor’s degree OR equivalent education/experience. Environment and Physical Demands Work is primarily sedentary in nature and can be executed sitting or standing positions in an office environment. Requires ability to utilize technology related to using a keyboard, verbal communication, and work with device screens which require visual acuity. If located in a company office, it often requires the mobility to physically navigate the space. In the event of business travel, mobility is sufficient to utilize public and private transport and navigate to essential locations. Position Overview and Objective The Senior Program Manager will manage and lead programs to drive the engineering development and implementation process for a subsystem and component of a product or service offering. Involvement lasts throughout all stages of a product’s lifecycle including ideation/concept, modifications, upgrades and maintenance of the product or product line. The Senior Program Manager will manage and lead strategic programs and initiatives within our cybersecurity software and services organization. This role is responsible for planning, executing, and delivering complex programs that align with business objectives, customer needs, and regulatory requirements. The ideal candidate will drive cross-functional collaboration, ensure program alignment with company strategy, and manage risks and dependencies to deliver high-quality security solutions on time and within budget. Responsibilities Strategic Influence & Thought Leadership – Guides executive decision-making on product strategy, technology investments, and long-term roadmap planning. Enterprise-Wide Program Management – Oversees multiple complex initiatives spanning business units, ensuring strategic objectives are met across products and teams. Technical Due Diligence – Leads deep dives into system architecture, performance, and scalability to assess risk and feasibility for high-impact initiatives. Executive & Stakeholder Alignment – Communicates trade-offs, investment rationales, and progress updates to C-suite and board-level stakeholders. Mentorship & Organization Impact – Develops best practices, frameworks, and coaching initiatives to elevate program management capabilities across the company. Lead and manage large-scale cybersecurity programs from initiation through completion, ensuring alignment with company objectives. Develop and maintain program roadmaps, timelines, and deliverables, ensuring effective coordination across engineering, product management, marketing, legal, sales and customer success teams. Oversee program governance, risk management, and compliance with industry security standards and regulations. Define and implement best practices for program execution, tracking, and reporting, ensuring visibility and accountability. Serves as the primary point of contact for program stakeholders, facilitating communication and alignment across business units. Manage budgets, resource allocation, and vendor relationships to optimize program efficiency. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance program execution, team collaboration, and customer satisfaction. Serves as the central resource with design, process, manufacturing, test, quality, and marketing as the product(s) move to production and distribution. Designs, develops, and manages activities for a specific product or group of products from product definition and planning through production, release, and end of life. Mentor direct and interdisciplinary team members. title: Senior Accountant - Financial Reporting
jobDescription: At Arctic Wolf, you won’t just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve – you'll help lead the change. Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We’re proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Gartner Peer Insights and IDC Market Scape – but what matters most is the work behind it: delivering real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora Platform. If you’re looking for meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high-growth company that’s redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you! Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for a / an Senior Accountant to be part of making this/that happen Position Overview and Objective The Financial Reporting Sr. Accountant is primarily responsible for preparing financial statements and reporting documents and coordinating international entities' audits. This role involves collaboration with various teams to compile, analyze, and report financial data. Responsibilities As a Senior Accountant at ARCTIC WOLF, you will: Financial reporting: Assist in quarterly and annual financial reporting by compiling and preparing income statements, balance sheets including footnotes, and other financial reports. Prepare financial statements tie out binder. Assist in coordinating annual audits and quarterly reviews with external auditors and corporate accounting team Prepare and submit surveys to industry organizations and publications. Research SEC filings for peer companies’ disclosure practices Manage various ad-hoc projects and deliverables and communicate promptly the status of each project to the reporting management Recommend and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency in financial reporting processes International Accounting: Manage international accounts audit by overseeing audit requirements and interacting with external auditors as required Help team with closing international accounting books on quarterly basis. Prepare schedules and support documentation related to audit Support local service providers to meet international regulatory compliance needs Take lead and partner with local services providers as needed to review and coordinate international statutory filings. Support efforts to improve processes and reporting, including standardization process Experience and Requirements: We’re looking for someone with experience in: Understanding the accounting principles Exceptional capability to meet tight deadlines and prioritize tasks effectively. Excellent analytical and organizational skills Strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively convey information to team members and stakeholders Ability to work on cross functional activities and form solid business relationships Must be available to work during US team hours a few days per month Preferred qualification Experience working with financial reporting software (DFIN or Workiva) Experience working with international accounting teams Knowledge of US GAAP and IFRS GAAP Chartered Accountant certification Education and experience Bachelor’s degree in accounting or finance Knowledge of India Accounting GAAP Minimum 4 years of post-qualification experience in multi-national companies On-Camera Policy To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including Top Workplace USA (2021-2025), Best Places to Work – USA (2021-2025), Great Place to Work – Canada (2021-2024), Great Place to Work – UK (2024-2026), and Kununu Top Company – Germany (2024-2026). Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We’re proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Bartner Peer Insights and IDC Market Scape – but what matters most is the work behind it: delivering real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora Platform. If you’re looking for meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high-growth company that’s redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you! Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for Senior Developer to be part of making this happen. Job Description Senior Developer A Python Developer has a clear history of successful contribution to professional software development projects. They are driven, curious, and results oriented. They are able to manage competing priorities as they relate to improving and maintaining existing 3rd-party integrations and constantly challenge the status quo. Basic Qualifications 5 or more years of professional experience as a Software Developer in an Agile environment Experience consists of contributing to projects preferably in Python. Experience consists of collaborating with multiple Software Developers while contributing code independently Experience consists of directly impacting the architecture and design of large scale, distributed systems Experience working in Agile development teams, preferably with formal Agile training A clear history of learning and skills development. Regularly helps software developers develop their skills in a variety of ways. Nice to have: Masters in Computer Science Nice to have: A clear history of technical influence (public conference talks, papers, etc) About the role You'll be working as a software developer in our Integration Maintenance Teams, responsible for maintaining and sustaining our 3rd party integrations and presenting actionable data to our Security Services teams. This team will be responsible for taking ownership of all the feature refreshes that happen from time to time for all the integrations. Some of your day-to-day responsibilities will be: Developing, maintaining and sustaining Python based applications, software, and systems. Collaborating with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and design software solutions. Writing clean, efficient, and reusable code in Python. Conducting code reviews and providing constructive feedback to ensure code quality and maintainability. Debugging and fixing issues in existing Python codebases. Optimizing application performance and ensuring scalability. Participate in the full software development life cycle, building well-designed, testable, efficient, secure code. Integrate software components into a fully functional software system; document and maintain software functionality. Understand the product and how Security Services delivers the service. Develop professional expertise, apply company policies and procedures to resolve a variety of issues. Determine a course of action based on guidelines, and modify processes and methods as required. Continuously learning and adopting best practices for code quality, software development methodologies, and programming principles to enhance coding skills and stay updated with industry advancements. We value a culture of sharing, so every team has the opportunity to share their work with the entire department during our monthly R&D Demos. Once a year we hold a department-wide Hackathon, teaming up across all R&D teams over four days to collaborate and build cool ideas outside the normal project scope. While innovation is the focus, some of these ideas do make it into our products. About you You're a talented software developer who loves building things and cares deeply about code quality and reliability while optimizing performance. You enjoy coordinating with distributed cross-functional teams. You are constantly adapting to emerging technologies, trends, and best practices. You will build productive internal/external working relationships to resolve mutual problems through collaboration, with a focus on providing standard professional advice and creating initial reports/analyses for review by experienced team professionals. Here are some of the core technologies we use and teach across our Integrations teams: Python Go AWS HTTP REST Git Jira Docker Kubernetes Syslog Pub/Sub Messaging Databricks You are not required to be an expert in any of these, but you should be excited by the opportunity to learn new things and comfortable with coming up to speed quickly. Any experience with full-stack development frameworks and practices is relevant and transferrable. You'll receive all the security training you need during our onboarding process and through additional training on the job. At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including Top Workplace USA (2021-2025), Best Places to Work – USA (2021-2025), Great Place to Work – Canada (2021-2024), Great Place to Work – UK (2024-2026), and Kununu Top Company – Germany (2024-2026). Effective communicator who can engage technical and non-technical stakeholders at all levels of the organization. Experience defining program metrics and driving measurable improvements in security outcomes. Experience with Responsible Disclosure and Bug Bounty programs Experience securing cloud-native applications and architectures in AWS, Azure, or GCP. Manage new releases of Salesforce and efficiently roll out new features. Demonstration of a disciplined change control process. Lead the design of end-to-end Salesforce architectures across Sales, Service, Experience Cloud and integrated systems. Knowledge and understanding of all integrations that exist within your tool set and how changes, enhancements and new functionality adds mesh with and possibly affect the AWN application ecosystem. Translate complex business needs into scalable, secure, high performing technical solutions. Define integration patterns, data models, and system interactions following Salesforce best practices. Responsible for configuration, design, functionality, and end-user support of the Salesforce application platform. Identify production risks and areas for improvement; prioritizes, designs and facilitates successful implementation and adoption of new processes Responsible for maintaining system security and integrity. Create and manage necessary documentation regarding Salesforce tool management. Troubleshoot all outages and produce root cause analysis reports as needed. This would include the ability to communicate with leaders and/or executive leadership as needed with updates during and after emergency outage windows. Lead install of new Managed Packages, enhancements and tools within Salesforce environment and assist with release prep communication and documentation review. Review and guide solution designs, configuration, and code for quality and performance. Provide technical leadership and mentorship to developers, admins, and project teams. Establish development standards, Dev Ops practices, and CI/CD pipelines. Define and enforce Salesforce governance, security, and data management standards. Oversee environment strategy, release management, and platform lifecycle processes. Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture and IT standards. Communicate complex technical concepts in ways that resonate with both technical and non‑technical audiences. Stay current with Salesforce releases and emerging capabilities. Recommend and drive enhancements that improve platform performance and business outcomes. Identify risks, anticipate challenges, and develop mitigation strategies. Key Skills A strategic thinker with strong technical depth and business acumen. Passionate about quality, scalability, and long-term maintainability.‑term maintainability. Curious, innovative, and always seeking better ways to leverage Salesforce. Strong problem-solving skills. Ability to understand our organization’s business. Ability to understand our Business Tool eco-system. Ability to quickly acquire working knowledge of connected business tools is a plus Solid understanding of how Salesforce connects to other internal applications, including owning the integration user set up and configuration. Ability to manage individual work efforts as part of Jira Sprint/Release process. Collaborative and consultative abilities to work with non-technical end users. Computer literate and proficient in standard office applications Word, Excel and Outlook. Minimum Qualifications 7+ years of hands-on experience with Salesforce architecture, development, and design. In-depth knowledge of the standard capabilities of Salesforce. Expertise with Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, APIs, and system integration patterns. Strong knowledge of Salesforce security models, data modeling, and governor limits. Experience designing solutions across Sales, Service, and/or Experience Cloud. Aptitude for eliciting user requirements and developing both process and technical solutions Experience developing and using Agentforce functionality. Background with Dev Ops tools Salesforce certifications such as Technical Architect, Application Architect, or System Architect. jobDescription:
At Arctic Wolf, you won’t just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve – you'll help lead the change. Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We’re proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Bartner Peer Insights and IDC Market Scape – but what matters most is the work behind it: delivering real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora Platform. If you’re looking for meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high-growth company that’s redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you! Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk.

ROLE:
Director of Product Operations
The Director of Product Operations role exists to define, drive adoption and accountability of an efficient software development lifecycle at Arctic Wolf. This individual will own codification of the product management outcomes through the SDLC, ensuring consistency in product management-specific documentation, standards, and training; owning the strategy and implementation for any product management specific SDLC tooling and to drive consistent adoption and accountability. This role will monitor the implementation of the SDLC to ensure the product management organization is consistently driving to the standard, identifying gaps, and driving solutions in collaboration with PM leaders. The Director of Operations is a strategic and execution‑focused leader responsible for driving operational excellence across the organization. This role oversees cross‑functional processes, ensures alignment between product, engineering, and business teams, and establishes scalable operational frameworks that enable growth and efficiency. The Director of Operations will partner closely with senior leadership to define operational strategy, optimize performance, and ensure organizational readiness as the business evolves. A key component of this role is serving as a subject matter expert (SME) in the Aha! product management platform or demonstrating significant experience with a comparable product management tool, ensuring strong transferable skills in product planning, roadmapping, workflow management, and cross‑team coordination. Primary Responsibilities and Duties Develop, implement, and continually refine operational strategies, processes, and systems that support organizational goals. Lead cross-functional initiatives that drive efficiency, operational alignment, and predictable delivery. Establish and manage performance metrics, operational dashboards, and reporting frameworks to monitor progress and inform decision‑making. Partner with Product Management, Engineering, and Program Management to streamline workflows, prioritize initiatives, and support successful execution of product roadmaps. Identify operational bottlenecks and implement solutions that improve throughput, quality, and scalability. Lead operational planning cycles, including annual planning, resourcing, and sequencing of strategic initiatives. Standardize processes, documentation, and governance to ensure clarity, accountability, and operational consistency across teams. Manage risk assessment and mitigation strategies, ensuring operational reliability. Serve as the organizational subject matter expert in Aha! or a similar product management tool, enabling teams to drive adoption, optimize usage, and leverage data for decision‑making. Support onboarding, training, and best‑practice integration for operations‑related tools and processes. Influence and support change‑management efforts to ensure smooth integration of new systems, tools, and methodologies. Influence Provide scalable solutions, like recorded training, best practices, templates, targeted coaching to product managers to facilitate the creation of high quality epics throughout the product lifecycle; supporting clear understanding of problems, suggested implementations and success metrics, and an effective refinement process with engineering Ensure product managers are creating and using effective, meaningful success metrics; In partnership with PMO, drive a process that regularly reviews deliverables against success criteria Assist product management leaders with best practices and tactics to drive product manager involvement throughout the entire SDLC to enable consistent communication of value, rapid problem solving, and quick scope adjustment Assist product management leaders with standard process for user acceptance test (beta, EAP, Design partners) and enabling cross-functional collaboration Ensure Product Marketing are embedded early and often in the product development lifecycle and the software development lifecycle Drive processes to enable high-impact UX engagement throughout the SDLC process so that UX time can be invested on the highest value work Foster an environment with early and often cross-functional collaboration and involvement (IT, Prod Sec, Legal, GTO, S2, etc) Facilitate quick decision-making by acting as the point of contact for prioritization assistance Own Product Organization Fiscal Year Annual Operating Planning process Product Organization Quarterly Business Review process Product Development Process and tools– “Product Manager of the Product Management process and implementation”; identify hotspots in the process to address and identify coaching opportunities; Develop a cadence of spot-checking product management processes as teams move through the development process to identify areas of growth for the teams and undesired friction in the process Identify opportunities to bring knowledge and data that provide value across all product management teams; implement ways to enable self-serve access to that knowledge and data Implement and maintain a road-mapping process that allows for efficient support of greenlight process requirements and consistently communicates and delivers customer and stakeholder value Own Product Management specific tooling (usage, contracting, mgmt); Drive consistent, standardized and efficient usage our tooling (Aha!, Jira, Confluence, XLS), determine what the right tool is for the outcome Own the pieces of the SDLC with product involvement; enable a culture of continuous learning and improvement; monitor the effective implementation of the SDLC, identify opportunities for tooling, process and people improvements and drive a metrics-oriented view of the health of the PM components of the SDLC Own and drive a set of metrics in support of the SDLC and at the discretion of the product SVP, to support the product lines as a whole function Own the business case template and lifecycle – from pitch through launch, ensuring clear reporting against goals throughout the lifecycle Own the product line strategy templates and lifecycle – Ensuring strategies include 3yr plan, where are you going, how you are going to win, supporting research; clear reporting against strategic goals for AWN Key Skills Strong operational strategy development and execution abilities Exceptional Product Management Knowledge – This role is the Product Manager of the Product Management process; must have a deep, experiential knowledge of product management and be able to translate that experience into best practices, templates and standardization Excellent cross-functional leadership, communication, and stakeholder‑management skills Expertise in scaling processes, optimizing workflows, and implementing operational frameworks Ability to analyze complex data, identify trends, and make data‑driven decisions Strong problem‑solving, critical thinking, and organizational skills High proficiency with operational and productivity tools Deep experience with Aha! or strong transferable expertise from similar tools (e.g., Jira Advanced Roadmaps, Productboard, Monday.com, etc.) Ability to influence without authority and build strong relationships across teams High EQ; able to build consensus without direct authority through ‘disagree and commit’ style agreements; Exemplary communicator across all mediums (Slack, Video, Email, Powerpoint, Word); Ability to influence and align across many stakeholder groups Strong presentation and executive communication skills Continuous Learner – researching new things to get better “Left Shift the problems” – driving towards continuous improvement as a culture Streamline Process to get the right outcomes– identify bottlenecks, and come up with solutions to remove the bottlenecks; implement scalable processes across product teams Extensive Agile SDLC experience, frameworks and tools Tempo Setter – not just a braintrust, evangelist of the process – driving culture and setting a tone; Advocate for excellence in the process – create a sense of spirit across teams; celebrate accomplishment & achievement, reinforcing good behaviors Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, Product Management, or related field 8+ years of experience in operations, program management, product operations, or a similar discipline Proven experience leading cross‑functional initiatives in a complex, fast‑paced environment Demonstrated ability to build and optimize operational processes Experience with Aha! or equivalent product‑management tools Strong analytical and reporting capabilities Preferred Qualifications Master’s degree (MBA or related discipline) 10–12+ years of experience in operations leadership roles Experience supporting product or technology organizations at scale Certification in Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, or similar methodologies Prior responsibility for tool governance, configuration, and enablement of Aha! or comparable platforms Experience in change management, organizational design, or operational maturity transformation Background in software or technology‑focused environments Don’t meet all the requirements? That’s okay! We still want you to apply. We have many opportunities, and we are always looking for top talent. This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (“EAR”).
